nodes.description: Address receiving marketplace swap fees; set in constructor and mutated by setFeeAddress.
Accumulated native-coin fees earned by the marketplace, incremented in multipleBuy.
Accumulated ERC20 fees earned by the marketplace, incremented in multipleBuy.
Mapping of pairId to Pair struct holding collection, tokenId, owner, price, balance and validity flag.
Monotonic identifier of the latest listing pair, incremented by 2 on each multipleList call.
Constant marketplace fee percentage (10) applied to the trade amount.
Array of created NFT collection addresses, appended in createCollection.
Owner-restricted setter that overwrites feeAddress after a zero-address check.
Deploys a MultipleNFT via create2 with a salt derived from uri, name and block.timestamp, then initializes it.
Lists NFTs for sale: pulls tokens via safeTransferFrom and writes a new Pair entry into pairs.
Delists a pair, returning escrowed NFTs to the recorded owner and clearing the balance/validity.
Purchases a listed NFT: computes price/fee splits, pays in ETH or ERC20, transfers the NFT to the buyer and decrements pair balance.
Deployment constructor assigning the initial feeAddress.
ERC1155Holder acceptance callback invoked on every safeTransferFrom to this contract.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for ownership checks, NFT transfers and payment flows.
Miner-influenced block.timestamp used as create2 salt entropy in createCollection.
Inline-assembly create2 deployment of MultipleNFT with a predictable, timestamp-derived salt.
External call nft.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), ...) in multipleList that can trigger receiver hooks.
External call returning escrowed NFTs to the pair owner in multipleDelist before/without reentrancy protection.
Native coin payouts to feeAddress, creator and owner executed before the pair balance is updated.
ERC20 transferFrom/transfer calls to arbitrary token contracts supplied by the listing creator.
NFT safeTransferFrom to the buyer at the end of multipleBuy, executing before pairs balance/validity state is updated.
Input parameter _address of setFeeAddress that becomes the new feeAddress.
Input parameter _id of multipleBuy selecting the pair to purchase.
Input parameter _amount of multipleBuy specifying how many NFT units to purchase.
Local variable tokenAmount = item.price.mul(_amount) used to derive fees and payouts.

edges.reason: msg.sender is validated against the owner in the onlyOwner modifier guarding setFeeAddress.
msg.sender is the owner recorded for the listing and the source of the escrowed NFTs in multipleList.
msg.sender must equal the pair owner or the contract owner before delisting.
msg.sender supplies payment and receives the NFT in multipleBuy without additional authorization.
block.timestamp is hashed into the create2 salt, making the collection address miner-influenced.
setFeeAddress writes the feeAddress state variable.
The constructor initializes feeAddress from its argument.
multipleBuy performs native-coin transfers to external addresses before updating pair balance and validity.
multipleBuy calls transferFrom/transfer on an attacker-supplied ERC20 contract before state finalization.
The NFT is transferred to the buyer before pairs[_id].balance and bValid are updated, violating checks-effects-interactions.
safeTransferFrom invokes onERC1155Received on the receiving contract, allowing re-entrant calls into multipleBuy.
multipleList calls nft.safeTransferFrom to escrow the tokens.
multipleDelist calls nft.safeTransferFrom to return escrowed tokens.
createCollection executes the inline-assembly create2 deployment.
multipleList writes the new Pair entry into the pairs mapping.
multipleDelist mutates the pair balance and bValid flag in the pairs mapping.
multipleBuy reads and decrements pairs[_id].balance and may clear bValid.
multipleList increments currentPairId via SafeMath add(2).
multipleBuy accumulates feeAmount into totalEarnedCoin.
multipleBuy accumulates feeAmount into totalEarnedToken.
createCollection pushes the newly created collection into the collections array.
Parameter _id selects which pair multipleBuy operates on.
Parameter _amount drives pricing and the balance decrement in multipleBuy.
tokenAmount feeds feeAmount, createrAmount and the native-coin payout amounts.
Parameter _address is validated then written into feeAddress by setFeeAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: The _address parameter has no independent identity outside the setFeeAddress state mutation and is absorbed into that core function node.
The _id parameter is only a pair selector for multipleBuy and carries no separate semantic role.
The _amount parameter is a transient purchase quantity consumed directly by multipleBuy arithmetic.
The tokenAmount local is a derived intermediate used solely to compute the ETH payout amounts, so it is merged into the native-transfer unsafe operation.
